lines.text: If you ever say her name three times in a dark mirror... don't turn around. She's already behind you.
It was my thirteenth birthday sleepover. Five girls, one bathroom, and one stupid dare.
Lights off. Candle on. Say it three times. Unless you're scared.
I wasn't scared. I stood in front of the mirror, with the candle shaking in my hand.
Before I could say it the third time... the candle went out by itself.
Everyone laughed. I didn't. Because in the mirror, my reflection was still holding a lit candle.
Then my reflection smiled. I wasn't smiling.
You didn't finish. Say it again.
I screamed and turned on the lights. The mirror was normal. Everyone said I made it up.
But the next morning, there were three words on the glass. Written from the other side.
So... how many times did you just say her name in your head?
